messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected for customer account `varuna-corp` on dedicated-eu-01. Error spike started ~05:22 UTC. Rule: 5xx >= 1% for 5m. CI: embeddings/generation.
oncall-sre: Acknowledged. Investigating. Pulling recent deploys + autoscaler events.
eng-lead: @oncall-sre thanks. Quick ask: any active rollouts to dedicated-eu in the last 2 hours?
oncall-sre: No deploys in last 3h per deploy-bot. Seeing CPU+GPU queue saturated on a subset of nodes, spikes in request queueing.
cs-rep: Flagging Varuna SOC and account team. Preparing a customer-facing note once we confirm impact.
acct-ops: Varuna is on reserved capacity; SLA target 99.95 for p95 latency. Need tailored comm if we expect customer impact >15m.
varuna-ops-liaison: Varuna ops here — we see retries and some user reports of delayed responses. Please keep us updated.
oncall-sre: Mitigation attempt 1: drain and restart affected worker pool (dedicated-eu-01-pool-b). Running: `kubectl cordon && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` to move traffic. Expect ~90s per pod.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: cordon/drain initiated by oncall-sre at 05:36 UTC. 4 pods affected.
eng-lead: Good. If restart recovery fails, fallback plan is to route Varuna traffic to dedicated-eu-02 (compatible model/runtime). Prep config now.
oncall-sre: Drain completed on 3/4 pods; one stuck terminating due to stuck gRPC connections. Forcing restart on that pod.
cs-rep: Drafting customer note (short): "We're investigating increased errors affecting your inference requests in EU. Engineers are mitigating; we'll send updates every 15 minutes. No data exposure suspected." Any edits?
varuna-ops-liaison: Please add: "We may see transient retries; recommend postponing large batch jobs for now."
acct-ops: Add SLA note: "We're prioritizing traffic to meet your reserved capacity; we'll escalate if restore >30m."
oncall-sre: Forced restart succeeded. Errors dropping but p95 still elevated. Active throttling observed from autoscaler (backlog -> throttles).
eng-lead: Can we temporarily disable aggressive autoscaler downscaling? That may reduce churn.
oncall-sre: Switched scaling policy to conservative for the pool. Also enabled short-term increase to burst capacity +2 GPUs for dedicated-eu. API routing updated.
incident-bot: routing-bot: traffic reweighted off eu-01-pool-b -> eu-02 pools at 05:49 UTC.
cs-rep: Updated customer snippet v2: "Issue identified with a subset of EU inference nodes causing intermittent 5xx errors. We've applied targeted restarts, adjusted scaling, and re-routed traffic; you may experience transient retries. Next update in 15 minutes."
eng-lead: Nice. Also add internal note for postmortem: include kernel OOM traces and KV cache pressure metrics.
oncall-sre: Current ETA to steady-state: ~10-20 minutes. Monitoring CPU/GPU queue, request success rate.
varuna-ops-liaison: Thank you. We'll relay to Varuna product + support. Please include any mitigation numbers once stable.
acct-ops: Preparing tailored status page entry for Varuna (reserved): "Varuna (reserved) — partial request failures in EU region. Mitigations in progress. No customer data impact. ETA 20m." Approving with legal is not required for this blurb.
incident-bot: statuspage-bot: Draft posted in staging at 05:54 UTC (internal review). Link: https://status.redwood.example/draft/6054321987
oncall-sre: p95 improving; error rate <0.3% now. Continuing to monitor for full recovery.
eng-lead: Start a TODO for post-incident: verify quantization path regression possibility, check kernel selection logs, and test traffic shaping policy.
cs-rep: Final customer update for now: "We've applied mitigations and traffic re-routing. Request success rates are improving; we'll follow up with a status update and RCA once we have root cause."
varuna-ops-liaison: Good. Sending to Varuna now.
oncall-sre: Handoff note for next on-call (@eng-sre oncall shift in 40m): system stable but watch for residual throttles and errors on eu-01; bucket metrics + node termination logs. 
eng-lead: Thanks team. If anything regresses, page SRE escalation channel. Also schedule incident review tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
incident-bot: [RESOLVE] Error rate returned to baseline for `varuna-corp` at 06:05 UTC. Thread closed pending postmortem.
